notes: This Web catalog contains 24 CC0/CC0-stated source recordings plus four synthesized sounds (underwater, white, pink, brown); the native production master plan still requires formal loudness, device and listening acceptance.
All recordings have provenance, source URL/page, publisher description, checksum and waveform/seam measurements. Temporary source downloads are not retained.

Names use the documented source content: rain includes thunder on 0740, umbrella rain is not certified thunder-free, train announcements may be present, café contains speech, ocean includes terns, chimes are studio/idealized, and bubbles are close-mug bubbles rather than deep-sea hydrophone audio.
Loops use overlap crossfades with rotated boundaries; no whole-clip fade. Fan and some short sources repeat internally, so long listening may reveal cycles.
No loudness normalization or compression standard was applied uniformly; validation checked audibility, peak headroom and clipping, not subjective timbre.
Assets are for this local self-use Web test; no upload or deployment occurred.
